definition: Microsoft interfaces that allow compatible hardware to accelerate video decoding and other video processing on Windows.
entry_text: Microsoft interfaces that allow compatible hardware to accelerate video decoding and other video processing on Windows.
example: A media player delegates supported decoding work to the graphics hardware.
label: DirectX Video Acceleration
sense_note: An API technology, not a standalone video player library.

sources.note: Microsoft describes the DXVA API and driver interface, and explains that codecs and video processors can offload work to the GPU.
